# apicurio_artifact (Data Source)

Reads an Apicurio Registry artifact. Uses v3 endpoints when available, otherwise falls back to v2.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact ID.
- `group_id` (String) Artifact group ID.

### Read-Only

- `content_id` (Number) Apicurio content ID (if exposed by the server).
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA256 of the latest content in the registry (best-effort).
- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC3339) if exposed by the server.
- `description` (String) Artifact description.
- `global_id` (Number) Apicurio global ID (if exposed by the server).
- `id` (String) Internal Terraform ID in the form `<group_id>/<artifact_id>`.
- `labels` (Set of String) Labels applied to the artifact.
- `latest_version` (String) Latest version string as reported by the server (best-effort).
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC3339) if exposed by the server.
- `name` (String) Artifact display name.
